name: Recycling
highLevelGoals: Enable users to easily find nearby recycling facilities and relevant information.
Allow users to manage their recycling preferences, favorite facilities, and receive relevant notifications.
Help users schedule and plan their recycling activities efficiently, including selecting waste types and planning optimal routes.
Motivate users to engage with the platform and recycle by offering tempting rewards.
Enable users to access documentation and contact administrators for feedback or help.
Maintain up-to-date and accurate information about recycling facilities.
Provide channels for users to give feedback and receive support, and for administrators to respond.
Enable administrators to communicate directly with facility representatives for updates and issue resolution.
Allow facility representatives to update their facility's details and accepted materials.
Enable facility representatives to communicate directly with site administrators regarding issues or concerns.
Enable superusers to update and manage information for their specific recycling centers.
Enable superusers to respond to user questions regarding their specific recycling centers.
lowLevelGoals: The system shall allow the user to retrieve a list of recycling facilities based on their current location or a specified address.
The system shall allow the user to filter the displayed recycling facilities by specific waste types they accept (e.g., plastic, paper, glass).
The system shall allow the user to select a recycling facility and view its detailed information, including operating hours, accepted materials, and contact details.
The system shall display the locations of recycling centers on an interactive map.
The system shall display the locations of public recycling bins on an interactive map.
The system shall display the locations of special waste drop-off sites on an interactive map.
The system shall allow the user to click on a facility's address to open an external navigation application (e.g., Google Maps) with the facility's location.
The system shall allow the user to filter recycling facilities based on environment-friendly criteria (e.g., certifications, energy usage).
The system shall allow the user to view a list of currently organized safe disposal events, including their dates, times, and locations.
The system shall allow the user to mark a recycling facility as a favorite for quick access.
The system shall allow the user to remove a previously saved recycling facility from their favorites list.
The system shall allow the user to set their preferred waste types for recycling, which can be used for personalized recommendations.
The system shall send notifications to the user about changes in operating hours or accepted materials for their favorited facilities.
The system shall send notifications to the user about new recycling events or initiatives.
The system shall allow the user to create a new account by providing an email address and password.
The system shall allow the user to link an email address to their account for password recovery purposes.
The system shall allow the user to specify the types of waste they intend to recycle for a planned trip.
The system shall generate an optimized route to one or more selected recycling facilities based on the user's current location and selected waste types.
The system shall allow the user to schedule a future recycling visit, including date, time, and selected facilities.
The system shall allow the user to upload their weekly schedule to receive personalized recommendations for recycling activities.
The system shall allow the user to view a list of available rewards for recycling activities.
The system shall allow the user to redeem accumulated points or credits for available rewards.
The system shall display the user's current recycling points or credits earned.
The system shall allow the user to access a searchable knowledge base or FAQ section.
The system shall allow the user to submit feedback, suggestions, or report issues to the administrators.
The system shall allow the user to send a support request to administrators, detailing their problem.
The system shall allow the administrator to add new recycling facilities to the database, including location, operating hours, and accepted materials.
The system shall allow the administrator to modify details of existing recycling facilities, such as operating hours, contact information, and accepted materials.
The system shall allow the administrator to delete recycling facility entries from the database.
The system shall allow the administrator to view and categorize submitted user feedback and suggestions.
The system shall allow the administrator to view and respond to user support requests.
The system shall allow the administrator to send direct messages to specific facility representatives regarding updates or issues.
The system shall allow the administrator to receive and view messages sent by facility representatives.
The system shall allow the facility representative to update the operating hours for their specific recycling facility.
The system shall allow the facility representative to update the list of accepted materials for their specific recycling facility.
The system shall allow the facility representative to update the contact information for their specific recycling facility.
The system shall allow the facility representative to send messages to site administrators regarding issues or concerns.
The system shall allow the facility representative to receive and view messages sent by administrators.
The system shall allow the superuser to modify the name, address, and general description of their assigned recycling center.
The system shall allow the superuser to modify the operating hours for their assigned recycling center.
The system shall allow the superuser to modify the list of accepted materials for their assigned recycling center.
The system shall allow the superuser to view a list of user questions specifically directed to their assigned recycling center.
The system shall allow the superuser to compose and send responses to user questions about their assigned recycling center.
